text: In this question you may need Tollens’ reagent. To prepare this, place a 2–3cm depth of aqueous
silver nitrate in a test-tube, add aqueous sodium hydroxide drop by drop until a small amount
of brown precipitate is formed and then add aqueous ammonia drop by drop with shaking until
the precipitate just dissolves. This is Tollens’ reagent. If Tollens’ reagent is used, ensure that all
test-tubes are thoroughly rinsed immediately after use.
